comment: Entries here are removed from preservation.json by diff-preservation.mjs before it compares two runs. Clock and counter text only.

patterns.reason: counter: the guide count in the label ('0 active') appears after a late update
clock and state: the archive job row carries a time stamp and a state that moves from accepted to completed
clock: the top bar clock; digits are normalised, but AM/PM changes when a run crosses noon
clock: the saved time stamp of the character colours scope line; AM/PM changes when a run crosses noon
clock: the time stamp title of a recent chat on the welcome screen; AM/PM changes when two runs fall either side of noon (M71 A9)

patterns.pathRegex: ^#neconyan-notes > div\[\d+\] > nav\[1\] > section\[\d+\] > ul\[1\] > li\[\d+\] > button\[1\] > span\[2\] > text\[1\]$
patterns.reason: clock: the saved time of a note in the Notes list; AM/PM changes when two runs fall either side of noon (M71 A9)
state: the Mewmory tab caption is briefly built before its state word is translated, on a different screen in each run (M71 A9)
